personality_one_liner: A highly functional, crisp, and trustworthy property management tool where content and reservation status take center stage against a clean Apple-native canvas.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Floating Action Buttons (e.g., AI assistant shortcut)

screens.name: Sign In
screens.purpose: Google sign-in gateway with a clean, welcoming hero property background.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a gradient scrim (top to bottom fade). Content pushed to the bottom third: App title, one-liner subtitle, and a prominent 'Continuer avec Google' primary CTA. Ensure safe-area clearance at the bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of today's operational tasks, earnings, and upcoming arrivals.

states.loading: Skeleton text and greyed-out metric boxes.
states.empty: Illustration with 'Aucune activité pour le moment'.
states.error: Error loading metrics with retry CTA.

screens.layout: Scrollable view. Top: Greeting & Quick stats grid (2 columns using space-between, showing occupancy & revenue). Middle: Horizontal scroll of 'Arrivées du jour' (Today's check-ins) using card layouts with status pills. Bottom: AI Assistant quick-access banner (Brand tinted background, suggesting a pricing review).

screens.name: Calendar
screens.purpose: Core reservation management where status colors shine.

states.empty: Empty desk illustration with 'Aucune réservation sélectionnée'.
states.error: Failed to sync calendar with retry CTA.

screens.layout: Top: Horizontal week or month picker. Below: Scrollable list of reservations for the selected period. Each reservation is a card with generous padding (md/lg). The status MUST be a prominent colored pill (Demande = warning, Confirmée = success, Arrivée = info, Départ = surfaceTertiary, Annulée = error). Include guest name, property, and dates.

screens.name: Properties
screens.purpose: Manage individual listings and their specific seasonal pricing.

states.empty: No properties found. Add your first listing.

screens.layout: Vertical list of large hero cards. Each card has a property image, gradient scrim, and white text for the property name. Below the image: quick metadata (current price, occupancy). Action button: 'Gérer les prix' (Manage pricing) linking to AI suggestions.

screens.name: AI Assistant
screens.purpose: Draft guest replies and receive seasonal pricing suggestions.

states.empty: Prompt suggestions like 'Draft welcome message' or 'Analyze July pricing'.
states.error: Failed to connect to AI with retry CTA.

screens.layout: Split functionality. Top tab or segmented control: 'Messages' vs 'Prix'. Messages view: Chat-like interface where host inputs guest query and AI generates a drafted reply in a surfaceSecondary bubble with 'Copy' button. Pricing view: A card showing recommended rate changes based on seasonality with an 'Appliquer' (Apply) CTA.

hero_property.alt: Modern cozy vacation rental house exterior with bright daytime sky

empty_desk.alt: Minimalist empty desk acting as a soft empty state background

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality exactly. High legibility, crisp sans-serif (Geist), generous whitespace, and minimal decorative borders.

CRITICAL: The user requested color-coded reservation stages. Implement this semantic mapping exactly on reservation pills/badges: Demande (Enquiry) = warning (#FF9500), Confirmée = success (#34C759), Arrivée (Check-in) = info (#32ADE6), Départ (Check-out) = surfaceTertiary text onSurfaceTertiary, Annulée = error (#FF3B30).
Use @expo/vector-icons AntDesign 'google' for the Google sign-in button since we don't use a full image logo.
For cards with background images (like Properties or Onboarding Hero), you MUST apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text readability.
Use Glassmorphism (expo-blur) for the bottom tab bar and sticky headers to provide that premium iOS feel, ensuring content gracefully scrolls underneath.

For the AI Assistant screen, prioritize a functional, native-feeling layout over 'sci-fi AI' aesthetics. Use standard system colors (brandPrimary or surfaceSecondary) rather than neon purples or blues for AI elements.
